explanation: An envoy or representative of Jesus Christ who was given authority to spread the gospel.
Actions, feats, or miracles performed by the disciples under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
A system of teaching based on human thought and logic about reality, often in contrast to God's revelation.
The Greek capital known for its culture of wisdom, art, and many deities that Paul visited.
An altar dedicated to an unknown or anonymous deity to avoid offending any of the many local gods in Athens.
The one God who created heaven and earth, not limited by human temples or images.
The event where Jesus Christ came back to life from the dead after three days, central to Christian faith.
The day when God will judge the whole world in righteousness through the risen Jesus.
